warnings: op1 direct read (house 11). SEISMIC ZONE PROVINCE LIST CONFIRMED — Zone 1 (13 provinces, higher risk) and Zone 2 (17 provinces incl. Bangkok) per กฎกระทรวง 2564. This directly explains why the BOQ has 6 blocks: general (no seismic detailing) + zone-1&2 variant (this sheet's tighter tie spacing) + zone-3 variant (S-15, presumably even tighter/heavier), each x2 for spread vs pile foundation.

Tie spacing tightens near beam/column joints (2h zone) per standard ductile seismic detailing — same principle as houses 08-10's twin-gable column ties, but here explicitly tied to a named code requirement (มยผ./กฎกระทรวง 2564) rather than just observed as a drawing pattern.

C0's 'ระดับอะเส' cell reads as a dash (no value) — C0 apparently has no ring-beam-level column continuation in the seismic-zone table, consistent with C0 being the anomalous isolated small-footing column whose superstructure is still not fully identified.
